theme.description: Professional agro, clean, minimalist with strict corporate identity 'Aplicaciones Fitosanidad — AJVJ Hidropónicos'. Focuses on functionality, data clarity, and an elevated B2B agricultural aesthetic.

families.heading: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

structure.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 h-full bg-[#4B5828] text-[#C8D4A0] hidden md:flex flex-col z-50
structure.header: h-16 sticky top-0 bg-[#FFFFFF] border-b border-[#e5e7eb] flex items-center px-6 z-40

buttons.primary: bg-[#4B5828] text-[#FFFFFF] hover:bg-[#3d4720] transition-colors rounded-[10px] px-4 py-2 font-medium focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#8FAD3C] focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#4B5828] border border-[#8FAD3C] hover:bg-[#C8D4A0]/20 transition-colors rounded-[10px] px-4 py-2 font-medium

tables.wrapper: w-full overflow-auto bg-[#FFFFFF] rounded-[10px] border border-[#e5e7eb]
tables.header: bg-[#4B5828] text-[#C8D4A0] text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-left
tables.row: border-b border-[#e5e7eb] last:border-0 even:bg-[#F5F5F0]/50 hover:bg-[#C8D4A0]/15 transition-colors

inputs.base: w-full border border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-[10px] px-3 py-2 bg-[#FFFFFF] text-[#1C1C1A] placeholder:text-[#737373] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#8FAD3C] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#8FAD3C] transition-all

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

images.description: AJVJ HIDROPÓNICOS corporate logo (olive green with greenhouse/plant icon). Note: Image has a black background originally, apply mix-blend-mode or place appropriately.
Hydroponic greenhouse interior. High tech organic feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the provided color palette. Do NOT use default tailwind blues, purples, or teals. #4B5828 is the core anchor.
Data-TestIDs: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu links) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-dashboard-link').
Use Recharts for all 8 charts required in the Dashboard. Style the charts using the brand colors (#4B5828, #8FAD3C, #C8D4A0).
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for layouts. Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dialogs, Selects) and customize their borders and radii to match rounded-[10px] and brand focus colors.
Implement a fixed vertical sidebar for desktop (w-64) with #4B5828 background, and use a hamburger menu for mobile devices.
Ensure table rows have alternating backgrounds and a hover state to make data scanning easier for the technical team.
Forms must support autocomplete where requested and use clear success/error/warning badges for inventory states.
